conf_method_witness.contract: the `conf_method_st.init` callback of the method table installed in the process-global `default_CONF_method` cell by the exported `CONF_set_default_method(CONF_METHOD *)`, or the built-in `NCONF_default()` table when the cell is NULL
conf_method_witness.provider_obligation: the application supplies a live `CONF_METHOD` whose `init` matches `conf_init_func`; `CONF_set_default_method` publishes it to every subsequent `CONF_set_nconf`, and the library calls it with a live `CONF *` it allocated itself
conf_method_witness.covers: the enumerated call site, the `default_CONF_method` cell, its two writer classes (the exported setter's parameter, and the built-in NULL fallback whose value is the table `NCONF_default()` returns), and the `ConfMethod.init` field at offset 0x10
does_not_cover: which method table an application installs; the setter is public and the target set is unbounded
the behaviour or lifetime of the installed `init` callback, or the application's own table contents
any field other than `init` at 0x10: a dispatch on `create` (0x8), `destroy` (0x18) or `destroy_data` (0x20) is a different contract and the witness refuses it
a writer of the cell outside the exported setter and the built-in fallback; the whole-image store scan refuses one
a runtime store to a `ConfMethod` `init` field anywhere under `src/`; the source scan refuses one (the only writers are the two link-time table literals)
citation: include/openssl/conf.h -- struct conf_method_st lists `int (*init)(CONF *conf)`; CONF_set_default_method(CONF_METHOD *meth) is the documented public setter; NCONF_default(void) publishes the built-in table
src/runtime/conf/types.rs:59-86 -- `#[repr(C)] ConfMethod` with `init` at offset 0x10 and type `Option<ConfInitFn>`

src/runtime/conf/lib.rs:54-55 -- `static DEFAULT_CONF_METHOD: AtomicPtr<ConfMethod>`; lib.rs:75-79 -- `CONF_set_nconf` installs `NCONF_default()` when the cell is NULL, then dispatches `(*meth).init`; lib.rs:96-107 -- the exported setter stores its `meth` parameter unchanged
src/runtime/conf/def.rs:808-834 -- the only two `ConfMethod` table literals (`DEFAULT_METHOD` -> def_init_default, `WIN32_METHOD` -> def_init_win32); no runtime store writes `init`
src/x509/v3_conf.rs:1629-1649 -- `X509V3_EXT_REQ_add_conf` calls `CONF_set_nconf(ctmp, NULL)` on its own `NCONF_new(NULL)` result, which the compiler inlines (the enumerated site)
